title: Filter a list with keep where
objective: Keep only the items of a list that pass a test, using keep ... where.

body.text: keep ... where gives back a new list with only the items that pass a test. The test is written after where, and it uses it for the current item. The original list does not change.

body.title: Keep the passing scores
body.code:
make scores equal to a list of 70, 90, 80
make passing equal to keep scores where it is at least 70
say first of passing

body.text: The test can read a field of a structure item, or use the size of a text. Use of it to reach a field of the current item.

body.title: Filter structures and text
body.code:
structure person
    has name of type text
    has age of type number

make people equal to a list of a person with name "Ada" and age 18
make adults equal to keep people where age of it is at least 18
say first of adults

make names equal to a list of "Ada", "Bobby", "C"
make short names equal to keep names where size of it is less than 8
say first of short names

body.prompt: The pass mark is 80, but the program still keeps scores of 60, so it reports 70 first. Make it report 90.
body.starter:
make scores equal to a list of 70, 90, 80
make passing equal to keep scores where it is at least 60
say first of passing
body.solution:
make scores equal to a list of 70, 90, 80
make passing equal to keep scores where it is at least 80
say first of passing
